KSGB Tournament Studio
PLAYER NAME

Player names and scores are directly editable on the display. Use these actions to prepare a new event.

ADD BULK PLAYER NAME

Copy 16 names from Notepad and paste one name per line. Lines 1–16 map to P1–P16. The matchup order is P1 vs P2, P3 vs P4, and so on.

0 of 16 names entered

Applying will replace all 16 player names. Existing scores stay unchanged, but winner highlights are cleared for safety.

SHUFFLE SEED

Randomize P1–P16 positions. All match scores and results are reset after confirmation.

Display Page

Use keys 1 / 2 to switch pages. Page 2 starts at TOP 8 and includes semifinals, final, third-place match, and a fifth-place consolation playoff.

Page Titles & Descriptions

Each page has its own editable heading. Click either heading directly on the display to edit.

Separate Page Backgrounds

Page 1 and Page 2 backgrounds are independent. Click unused background space on either page to replace that page’s image only while NOT fullscreen.

Overlay (between background and player cards)

Overlay is behind the matchups, player names and scores.

Display
Layout

Top: editable title and description. Middle: 8 VS matchups. Bottom: approximately 130 px reserved for sponsor logos incorporated into your background image. The sponsor area stays clear of match cards and titles.

Direct Editing

Windowed editing is always on. In fullscreen press E to toggle text editing. Press Escape to cancel a text change.

BRACKET RESULTS

Page 2: in Edit Mode, click a name or score to edit, or click its match badge to select the winner. Top 8 losers enter the 5th-place playoff; semifinal losers play for 3rd. Scores reset if an incoming competitor changes.

Actions

Reset commands are available at the top of Settings.

Player swaps exchange names and scores; any winner selection involved is reset. Scores and names are saved in this browser.

Windowed mode is editable automatically. Fullscreen shows no edit-mode label; press E to toggle text editing. Click another field to save the previous text. Background editing is disabled in fullscreen.
